import os, json
root = '/Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/src/components'
missing = []
components = []
stories = set()

for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
    # Skip typical non-component directories
    if any(part in dirpath for part in ['__tests__', '__mocks__']):
        continue
    for f in filenames:
        if f.endswith('.tsx'):
            full = os.path.join(dirpath, f)
            rel = os.path.relpath(full, root)
            if f.endswith('.stories.tsx'):
                stories.add(full)
                continue
            if f == 'index.tsx' or f.endswith('.test.tsx') or f.endswith('.spec.tsx'):
                continue
            components.append(full)

stories_by_dir = {}
for s in stories:
    stories_by_dir.setdefault(os.path.dirname(s), set()).add(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(s))[0].replace('.stories',''))

missing_list = []
for comp in components:
    d = os.path.dirname(comp)
    b = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(comp))[0]
    story_tsx = os.path.join(d, b + '.stories.tsx')
    story_mdx = os.path.join(d, b + '.stories.mdx')
    if not (os.path.exists(story_tsx) or os.path.exists(story_mdx)):
        missing_list.append(comp)

by_dir = {}
for path in missing_list:
    d = os.path.dirname(path)
    by_dir[d] = by_dir.get(d, 0) + 1

summary = {
    'root': root,
    'total_components_scanned': len(components),
    'total_stories_found': len(stories),
    'missing_stories_count': len(missing_list),
    'missing_examples_first_50': [os.path.relpath(p, root) for p in missing_list[:50]],
    'by_directory_top_20': sorted(((k, v) for k, v in by_dir.items()), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)[:20],
}

print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))

# Save full list to file
out_dir = '/Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/docs/PLANS/fixes'
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, 'MissingStories.report.json')
with open(out_path, 'w') as f:
    json.dump({
        'root': root,
        'missing': [os.path.relpath(p, root) for p in missing_list],
        'by_directory': by_dir,
    }, f, indent=2)
print('\nSaved full report to', out_path)

    d = os.path.dirname(comp)
    b = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(comp))[0]
    story_tsx = os.path.join(d, b + '.stories.tsx')

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Enhanced AI-powered connection analysis using OpenAI and contextual intelligence\n * Builds on existing contextual intelligence to provide sophisticated connection suggestions\n */\nexport async function analyzeSmartConnections({\n  nodes,\n  graphContext,\n  analysisDepth = 'quick'\n}: ConnectionAnalysisRequest): Promise\u003cConnectionAnalysisResult\u003e {\n  if (!process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      connections: [],\n      insights: [],\n      error: \"OpenAI API key not configured\"\n    }\n  }\n\n  try {\n    // Limit nodes for API performance\n    const nodesToAnalyze = nodes.slice(0, analysisDepth === 'comprehensive' ? 20 : analysisDepth === 'deep' ? 12 : 8)\n    \n    // Generate contextual search rules for additional context\n    const contextualRules = graphContext ? generateContextualSearchRules(graphContext) : ''\n    \n    // Prepare node data for analysis\n    const nodeData = nodesToAnalyze.map(node =\u003e ({\n      id: node.id,\n      type: node.data?.type || 'unknown',\n      name: node.data?.name || node.data?.title || node.data?.label || 'Unknown',\n      date: node.data?.date || node.data?.occurred_on || node.data?.timestamp,\n      location: {\n        latitude: node.data?.latitude || node.data?.lat,\n        longitude: node.data?.longitude || node.data?.lon || node.data?.lng\n      },\n      personnel: extractPersonnelFromData(node.data),\n      organizations: extractOrganizationsFromData(node.data),\n      topics: extractTopicsFromData(node.data),\n      description: node.data?.description || node.data?.summary || '',\n      significance: node.data?.significance || node.data?.importance\n    }))\n\n    // Create analysis prompt based on depth\n    const systemPrompt = getSystemPrompt(analysisDepth)\n    const userPrompt = getUserPrompt(nodeData, contextualRules, analysisDepth)",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Normalize both sightings and events data into a common format for analysis\n *\n * @param sightingsData - Array of sightings data\n * @param eventsData - Array of events data\n * @returns Normalized data array\n */\nfunction normalizeDataForAnalysis(\n\tsightingsData: SightingData[],\n\teventsData: EventData[],\n): Array\u003c{\n\tid: string;\n\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\ttitle: string;\n\tdescription: string;\n\tdate: Date;\n\tlocation: {\n\t\tname: string;\n\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t};\n\tshape?: string;\n\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n}\u003e {\n\t// Process sightings\n\tconst normalizedSightings = sightingsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"sighting\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || \"UAP Sighting\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.content,\n\t\t\tdate: item.timestamp,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location?.city || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || item.category?.[0],\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Process events\n\tconst normalizedEvents = eventsData.map((item) =\u003e {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tid: item.id,\n\t\t\ttype: \"event\" as const,\n\t\t\ttitle: item.title || item.name || \"Event\",\n\t\t\tdescription: item.description,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\t\tname: item.location || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates:\n\t\t\t\t\titem.latitude \u0026\u0026 item.longitude\n\t\t\t\t\t\t? { lat: item.latitude, lng: item.longitude }\n\t\t\t\t\t\t: undefined,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category,\n\t\t\toriginalItem: item,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\n\t// Combine and return\n\treturn [...normalizedSightings, ...normalizedEvents];\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Prepares a summary of combined sightings and events data for AI analysis\n *\n * @param normalizedData - Normalized data array containing both sightings and events\n * @returns Summarized data suitable for AI analysis\n */\nfunction prepareCombinedDataSummary(\n\tnormalizedData: Array\u003c{\n\t\tid: string;\n\t\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\t\ttitle: string;\n\t\tdescription: string;\n\t\tdate: Date;\n\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\tname: string;\n\t\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t\t};\n\t\tshape?: string;\n\t\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\t\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n\t}\u003e,\n) {\n\t// Limit the number of full descriptions to avoid token limits\n\tconst MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS = 50;\n\n\t// Separate sightings and events\n\tconst sightings = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"sighting\");\n\tconst events = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"event\");\n\n\t// Create a combined summary\n\tconst summary = {\n\t\ttotalSightings: sightings.length,\n\t\ttotalEvents: events.length,\n\t\tlocationData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tlocation: item.location?.name || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates || null,\n\t\t})),\n\t\ttemporalData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t})),\n\t\tshapeData: sightings.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\tcategoryData: events.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\t// Limit full descriptions to save tokens\n\t\tdescriptions: normalizedData\n\t\t\t.slice(0, MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS)\n\t\t\t.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\t\tdescription: item.description || \"No description\",\n\t\t\t})),\n\t};\n\n\treturn summary;\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Prepares a summary of combined sightings and events data for AI analysis\n *\n * @param normalizedData - Normalized data array containing both sightings and events\n * @returns Summarized data suitable for AI analysis\n */\nfunction prepareCombinedDataSummary(\n\tnormalizedData: Array\u003c{\n\t\tid: string;\n\t\ttype: \"sighting\" | \"event\";\n\t\ttitle: string;\n\t\tdescription: string;\n\t\tdate: Date;\n\t\tlocation: {\n\t\t\tname: string;\n\t\t\tcoordinates?: { lat: number; lng: number };\n\t\t};\n\t\tshape?: string;\n\t\tcategory?: string | string[];\n\t\toriginalItem: SightingData | EventData;\n\t}\u003e,\n) {\n\t// Limit the number of full descriptions to avoid token limits\n\tconst MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS = 50;\n\n\t// Separate sightings and events\n\tconst sightings = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"sighting\");\n\tconst events = normalizedData.filter((item) =\u003e item.type === \"event\");\n\n\t// Create a combined summary\n\tconst summary = {\n\t\ttotalSightings: sightings.length,\n\t\ttotalEvents: events.length,\n\t\tlocationData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tlocation: item.location?.name || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t\tcoordinates: item.location?.coordinates || null,\n\t\t})),\n\t\ttemporalData: normalizedData.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\tdate: item.date,\n\t\t})),\n\t\tshapeData: sightings.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tshape: item.shape || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\tcategoryData: events.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\tcategory: item.category || \"Unknown\",\n\t\t})),\n\t\t// Limit full descriptions to save tokens\n\t\tdescriptions: normalizedData\n\t\t\t.slice(0, MAX_FULL_DESCRIPTIONS)\n\t\t\t.map((item) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\ttype: item.type,\n\t\t\t\tdescription: item.description || \"No description\",\n\t\t\t})),\n\t};\n\n\treturn summary;\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Enhanced function to get node data with Prometheus AI integration\nexport async function getEnhancedNodeData(\n  question: string,\n  table: string,\n  rules?: string\n): Promise\u003c{answer: string; records: any[]; sessionId: string; reasoning?: any[]}\u003e {\n  try {\n    console.log('🤖 Getting enhanced node data via Prometheus')\n\n    // First, use the existing search database function to get actual records\n    const searchResults = await searchDatabase({\n      table,\n      searchTerms: [question],\n      searchFields: ['name', 'description', 'summary', 'title'],\n      limit: 3, // Limit to 3 as per user requirements\n      sortBy: 'relevance',\n    })\n\n    console.log('🔍 Search results:', searchResults)\n\n    if (searchResults.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        answer: 'No relevant records found',\n        records: [],\n        sessionId: '',\n        reasoning: [],\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Enhanced prompt to get specific reasoning for each record selection\n    const recordSummaries = searchResults\n      .map(\n        (record, index) =\u003e\n          &#96;Record ${index + 1}: ${record.name || record.title || &#96;ID: ${record.id}&#96;} - ${record.description || record.summary || 'No description'}&#96;\n      )\n      .join('\\n')\n\n    const analysisPrompt = &#96;You are analyzing ${table} records related to the query: \"${question}\"\n\nFound Records:\n${recordSummaries}\n\n${rules || 'Provide contextual insights and connections.'}\n\nPlease provide:\n1. Overall analysis of why these ${table} records are relevant to \"${question}\"\n2. For each record, explain specifically WHY it was chosen and its connection to the original query\n3. +"use client"
+
+import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react"
+import { format } from "date-fns"
+import "./terminal.css"
+
+type TerminalMetrics = {
+  totalSightings: number
+  eventsCount: number
+  topShape?: string
+  topCity?: string
+  latestSightingISO?: string
+  timeRange?: { startYear?: number; endYear?: number; selectedYear?: number }
+}
+
+interface TerminalProps {
+  metrics?: TerminalMetrics
+  status?: "ACTIVE" | "DEGRADED" | "OFFLINE"
+  progress?: number
+  logs?: string[]
+}
+
+export function Terminal({ metrics, status = "ACTIVE", progress = 100, logs = [] }: TerminalProps) {
+  const terminalLinesRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement[]&gt;([])
+  const progressFillRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)
+  const terminalWindowRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null)
+
+  useEffect(() =&gt; {
+    // Show the terminal window
+    if (terminalWindowRef.current) {
+      setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+        terminalWindowRef.current!.style.opacity = "1"
+        terminalWindowRef.current!.style.width = "100%"
+        animateTerminalText()
+      }, 500)
+    }
+
+    // Fill the progress bar to the provided percentage
+    if (progressFillRef.current) {
+      setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+        progressFillRef.current!.style.width = &#96;${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress))}%&#96;
+      }, 600)
+    }
+    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
+  }, [progress])
+
+  // Function to animate terminal text
+  const animateTerminalText = () =&gt; {
+    // Make all lines visible with a staggered delay
+    terminalLinesRef.current.forEach((line, index) =&gt; {
+      if (line) {
+        setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+          line.style.opacity = "1"
+          line.classList.add("visible")
+        }, index * 80) // 80ms delay between each line
+      }
+    })
+  }
+
+  // Function to set terminal line refs
+  const setTerminalLineRef = (el: HTMLDivElement | null, index: number) =&gt; {
+    if (el) {
+      terminalLinesRef.current[index] = el
+    }
+  }
+
+  const uiDate = (iso?: string) =&gt; {
+    try {
+      return iso ? format(new Date(iso), "MMMM do yyyy") : "N/A"
+    } catch {
+      return "N/A"
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Build terminal output lines from real metrics
+  const terminalLines = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+    const m = metrics || {
+      totalSightings: 0,
+      eventsCount: 0,
+    }
+
+    const rangeSuffix = m?.timeRange?.selectedYear
+      ? &#96;Year ${m.timeRange.selectedYear}&#96;
+      : m?.timeRange?.startYear &amp;&amp; m?.timeRange?.endYear
+      ? &#96;${m.timeRange.startYear}–${m.timeRange.endYear}&#96;
+      : ""
+
+    const dynamicLines: string[] = [
+      "$ system.initialize()",
+      "Initializing systems...",
+      "&lt;span class='success'&gt;SUCCESS:&lt;/span&gt; Runtime ready",
+      "&amp;nbsp;",
+      "$ loadFeeds()",
+      &#96;- sightings: &lt;span class='success'&gt;${m.totalSightings.toLocaleString()}&lt;/span&gt; records&#96;,
+      &#96;- events: &lt;span class='success'&gt;${m.eventsCount.toLocaleString()}&lt;/span&gt; records&#96;,
+      rangeSuffix ? &#96;- range: ${rangeSuffix}&#96; : "- range: N/A",
+      "&amp;nbsp;",
+      "$ analyze()",
+      &#96;Top shape: ${m.topShape || "N/A"}&#96;,
+      &#96;Hotspot city: ${m.topCity || "N/A"}&#96;,
+      &#96;Latest sighting: ${uiDate(m.latestSightingISO)}&#96;,
+      "&amp;nbsp;",
+      "$ status()",
+      &#96;System Status: ${status}&#96;,
+      "Threat Level: LOW",
+      "Data Integrity: 99.7%",
+      "&amp;nbsp;",
+      ...logs,
+      "$ _",
+    ]
+    return dynamicLines
+    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
+  }, [metrics, status, logs?.length])
+
+  return (
+    &lt;div className="terminal-container w-full p-2"&gt;
+      {/* Terminal Window */}
+      &lt;div className="terminal-window w-full" ref={terminalWindowRef}&gt;
+        &lt;div className="terminal-header"&gt;
+          &lt;span className="terminal-title"&gt;SYS_TERM_V42.EXE&lt;/span&gt;
+          &lt;div className="terminal-controls"&gt;
+            &lt;span className="terminal-control"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
+            &lt;span className="terminal-control"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
+            &lt;span className="terminal-control"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
+          &lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;div className="terminal-content"&gt;
+          {terminalLines.map((line, index) =&gt; (
+            &lt;div
+              key={index}
+              className="terminal-line"
+              ref={(el) =&gt; setTerminalLineRef(el, index)}
+              dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: line }}
+            &gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+          ))}
+        &lt;/div&gt;
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+
+      {/* Progress bar at bottom */}
+      &lt;div className="progress-container"&gt;
+        &lt;div className="progress-label"&gt;TERMINAL&lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;div className="progress-bar"&gt;
+          &lt;div className="progress-fill" ref={progressFillRef}&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;/div&gt;
+        &lt;div className="progress-close"&gt;[X]&lt;/div&gt;
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+    &lt;/div&gt;
+  )
+}
*** End Patch

*** Add File: docs/PLANS/features/sightings/TerminalUI_PSEUDOCODE.md
+# Terminal UI – Pseudocode
+
+Goal: Replace placeholder terminal text with real metrics derived from sightings and events, and render them in the sidebar terminal under the Sightings HUD.
+
+Inputs
+- &#96;initialSightings: ValidatedUAPSighting[]&#96;
+- &#96;events: Array&lt;{ id: string; title?: string; name?: string; description: string; date: Date; latitude?: number; longitude?: number; category?: string }&gt;&#96;
+- &#96;selectedYear: number&#96; (filtering state)
+
+Data Derivation
+1. Filter by selected year
+   - yearStart = Date(&#96;${selectedYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;)
+   - yearEnd = Date(&#96;${selectedYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;)
+   - filteredSightings = initialSightings.filter(ts within [yearStart, yearEnd])
+   - filteredEvents = events.filter(date within [yearStart, yearEnd])
+
+2. Compute metrics
+   - totalSightings = filteredSightings.length
+   - eventsCount = filteredEvents.length
+   - topShape
+     - counts = {}
+     - for sighting in filteredSightings:
+       - for shape in sighting.category (array or string): counts[shape]++
+     - topShape = max(counts) key
+   - topCity
+     - cityCounts = {}
+     - for sighting in filteredSightings: if sighting.location.city: cityCounts[city]++
+     - topCity = max(cityCounts) key
+   - latestSightingISO
+     - latest = sort(filteredSightings by timestamp desc)[0]
+     - latestSightingISO = latest?.timestamp.toISOString()
+   - timeRange = { selectedYear }
+
+3. Build terminal lines (strings)
+   - Header: &#96;$ system.initialize()&#96;
+   - Feeds: &#96;- sightings: &lt;count&gt;&#96;, &#96;- events: &lt;count&gt;&#96;, &#96;- range: Year &lt;selectedYear&gt;&#96;
+   - Analysis: &#96;Top shape&#96;, &#96;Hotspot city&#96;, &#96;Latest sighting: &lt;MMMM do yyyy&gt;&#96;
+   - Status: &#96;System Status: ACTIVE&#96;, etc.
+
+Rendering
+- Component &#96;&lt;Terminal metrics={...} status="ACTIVE" progress={100} /&gt;&#96;
+- In &#96;Terminal&#96;, memoize &#96;terminalLines&#96; from &#96;metrics&#96; and format dates with &#96;date-fns&#96; (&#96;MMMM do yyyy&#96;).
+- Animate lines visibility on mount; set progress bar width to &#96;progress%&#96;.
+
+Globe Data (fix types)
+- Map filtered points (sightings + events) to &#96;Position[]&#96; arcs expected by &#96;ThreeJsGlobe&#96;:
+  - Accumulate all &#96;{lat, lng}&#96; points
+  - For i in 1..N-1 create arc from points[i-1] -&gt; points[i]
+  - Use color &#96;#78efff&#96; and &#96;arcAlt = 0.2&#96;.
+
+Outputs
+- Real-time terminal panel with counts, top shape/city, latest sighting date.
+- Globe receives correctly typed &#96;Position[]&#96;.
+
*** End Patch

*** Add File: docs/PLANS/features/sightings/TerminalUI.md
+## Terminal UI – Real Data Integration
+
+This document describes the implementation that wires real sightings/events data into the Sightings HUD terminal panel.
+
+### Scope
+- Replace hardcoded terminal text with metrics derived from filtered data.
+- Keep UI aesthetic; only the textual lines and progress value change.
+- Ensure type-safe wiring to &#96;ThreeJsGlobe&#96; by converting data to the expected &#96;Position[]&#96; arcs.
+
+### Key Modules
+- &#96;apps/app/src/features/data-viz/sightings/uap-dashboard/HudUapInterface.tsx&#96;
+  - Filters data by year, computes metrics, generates &#96;Position[]&#96; for the globe, passes metrics to terminal.
+- &#96;apps/app/src/features/data-viz/sightings/uap-dashboard/terminal/terminal.tsx&#96;
+  - New props: &#96;metrics&#96;, &#96;status&#96;, &#96;progress&#96;, &#96;logs&#96;.
+  - Formats dates with &#96;date-fns&#96; using &#96;MMMM do yyyy&#96; per date-formatting rule.
+  - Animates lines and progress bar.
+- &#96;apps/app/src/components/globes/threejs-globe.tsx&#96;
+  - Reference for &#96;Position&#96; and &#96;WorldProps&#96; types.
+
+### Data Flow
+1. Server page &#96;sightings/page.tsx&#96; fetches &#96;sightings&#96; and &#96;events&#96;.
+2. Client &#96;SightingsClient&#96; hands them to &#96;HudUapInterface&#96;.

```diff
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: apps/app/.storybook/decorators/reference-assets.tsx
+import type {DecoratorFunction} from '@storybook/types'
+import type {ReactRenderer} from '@storybook/react'
+import React from 'react'
+
+type RefItem = {
+  src: string
+  alt?: string
+  caption?: string
+  href?: string
+}
+
+type RefAssetsParams = {
+  title?: string
+  position?: 'top' | 'bottom'
+  maxWidth?: number | string
+  items?: RefItem[]
+  images?: RefItem[]
+  assets?: RefItem[]
+}
+
+function resolveItems(params?: RefAssetsParams): RefItem[] {
+  if (!params) return []
+  return params.items || params.images || params.assets || []
+}
+
+export const withReferenceAssets: DecoratorFunction&lt;ReactRenderer, any&gt; = (Story, context) =&gt; {
+  const cfg = (context.parameters as any).referenceAssets as RefAssetsParams | undefined
+  const items = resolveItems(cfg)
+  if (!cfg || items.length === 0) return &lt;Story /&gt;
+
+  const section = (
+    &lt;section
+      className='w-full max-w-6xl mx-auto my-4 px-4'
+      style={{maxWidth: cfg.maxWidth || '1200px'}}&gt;
+      &lt;div className='mb-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.35em] text-zinc-400'&gt;
+        {cfg.title || 'Reference Images'}
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+      &lt;div className='grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3'&gt;
+        {items.map((it, idx) =&gt; (
+          &lt;figure key={idx} className='rounded border border-white/10 bg-white/5 overflow-hidden'&gt;
+            {it.href ? (
+              &lt;a href={it.href} target='_blank' rel='noreferrer'&gt;
+                &lt;img src={it.src} alt={it.alt || 'reference'} className='w-full h-48 object-cover' /&gt;
+              &lt;/a&gt;
+            ) : (
+              &lt;img src={it.src} alt={it.alt || 'reference'} className='w-full h-48 object-cover' /&gt;
+            )}
+            {(it.caption || it.alt) &amp;&amp; (
+              &lt;figcaption className='p-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-300'&gt;
+                {it.caption || it.alt}
+              &lt;/figcaption&gt;
+            )}
+          &lt;/figure&gt;
+        ))}
+      &lt;/div&gt;
+    &lt;/section&gt;
+  )
+
+  return (
+    &lt;&gt;
+      {cfg.position === 'top' ? section : null}
+      &lt;Story /&gt;
+      {cfg.position !== 'top' ? section : null}
+    &lt;/&gt;
+  )
+}
+
*** End Patch
```

Status: Added a reusable Storybook decorator to show reference images/screenshots per story and wired it globally.

How it works
- New file: `apps/app/.storybook/decorators/reference-assets.tsx`
  - Global decorator `withReferenceAssets` reads `parameters.referenceAssets`.
  - Renders a responsive grid of images with optional captions and links.
  - Supports `position: 'top' | 'bottom'`, `title`, `maxWidth`, and `items|images|assets` arrays.

- Registered globally:
  - `apps/app/.storybook/preview.tsx`
    - `import {withReferenceAssets} from './decorators/reference-assets'`
    - Added to `decorators` before the theme wrapper so it appears for all stories.

Usage in a story
Add `parameters.referenceAssets` to any story:
```ts
export const ExampleStory = {
  parameters: {
    referenceAssets: {
      title: 'Design References',
      position: 'top',
      items: [
        { src: '/images/doc-a-main.png', alt: 'Doc A' },
        { src: '/images/doc-b-abstract.png', alt: 'Abstract' },
        { src: 'https://picsum.photos/800/600', alt: 'External sample', href: 'https://picsum.photos' },
      ],
    },
  },
} satisfies Story
```

Notes
- This complements, not replaces, the addon-design-assets panel. It renders references directly in the canvas for side-by-side comparison. For panel-based assets, keep using the official addon panels ([addon-design-assets], [addon-designs]) from Storybook docs and repo: [https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-design-assets], [https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-designs], [https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook].
